title: 139 Laredoans Learn Diabetes Prevention at Community Health Event
excerpt: Gateway Community Health Center, the Mexican Consulate of Laredo and the Laredo Regional Food Bank teamed up for a diabetes awareness event on Nov. 12 that drew 139 patients and community members.
content:
Gateway Community Health Center Inc., the Mexican Consulate of Laredo and the Laredo Regional Food Bank teamed up for a diabetes awareness event on Thursday, Nov. 12, that drew 139 patients and community members.

The event focused on education and information. Attendees learned about diabetes prevention and management, diabetes awareness and self-management, and the impact of stress on overall health.

Oscar Montiel shared a testimonial about the importance of managing diabetes, putting a personal face on the health information shared during the event.

Attendees also went home with grocery bags containing bread, fresh fruits and vegetables — including tomatoes, cucumbers and bell peppers — and other food items, connecting the day's lessons to healthy eating at home.

Throughout the rest of the month, Gateway employees were to wear diabetes awareness pins, distributed to all staff by the Health Education Department.

Source: Gateway Community Health Center, Nov. 22, 2026.
